comparatorRegret_eq_sum: theorem comparatorRegret_eq_sum {X : Type*} (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X) (u : X) (T : ℕ) : comparatorRegret loss prediction u T = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (loss t (prediction t) - loss t u)
noRegret_of_vanishing_bound: theorem noRegret_of_vanishing_bound {X : Type*} (V : Set X) (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X) (bound : X → ℕ → ℝ) (hb : ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T ≤ bound u T) (hl : ∀ u ∈ V, Tendsto (bound u) atTop (nhds 0)) : NoRegret V loss prediction
